[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 75
- Description: Oracle: fix "hexagramChinese is not a function" regression + live verification
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/oracle/pull/72
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/oracle/pull/71
  
  Details:
  Follow-up to the Chinese hexagram names work (#71). Gary hit `hexagramChinese is not a function` when clicking "Toss All Lines" — a regression shipped in #71.
  
  Root cause: a global-name collision. scripts/hexagram_chinese.js (defer) did `window.hexagramChinese = {…}` (an object) while the inline script declared `function hexagramChinese(…)`. A classic top-level function declaration and a window property share one global binding, so the deferred map overwrote the function → every call threw.
  
  Fix (PR #72): renamed the map global to window.HEXAGRAM_CHINESE and pointed the helper at it — 15-line diff across 3 files. Replaced the weak "file exists" test with a real invariant: the map's global name must not equal any helper declared in the inline script (mapGlobals ∩ inlineHelpers === ∅).
  
  Verified live on oracle.truesight.me: map global = HEXAGRAM_CHINESE, helper reads it, functional test loads the live JS and confirms typeof hexagramChinese === "function" with all 64 entries (1→乾, 64→未濟, etc.).
  
  Suite: 27 passed; the 2 dao-client failures reproduce on a clean main clone (upstream rc.3→rc.4 unpkg drift) — pre-existing.
  
  Also incl. this thread's earlier diagnosis of the advisory failure: nginx logs show 5× HTTP 499 (client aborted) on the ~11–16s advisory call, no 429/502/504 — an interactive endpoint too slow for mobile, rendered as a hard error. Fix scoped, awaiting governor pick.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 125.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
